overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine AI editorial criteria using category weights (AI job fit 16, output quality 14, ease of use 12, workflow depth 12, integrations 10, governance/privacy 10, value 10, model capability 8, scalability 8), rounded to 1 decimal.
